title: Remove Weeknd track reference and add girlfriend photo corner image

requirements.text: Remove the “Earned It — The Weeknd” song from the Valentine page by eliminating any Weeknd-specific labeling and not hardcoding the audio source to an “earned-it” file; keep the existing local-audio-only playback controls (play/pause, mute, volume) but make the UI copy generic so users can supply their own local audio file.
acceptanceCriteria: The music section does not display the text “Earned It — The Weeknd” anywhere in the UI.
The app does not hardcode the audio source to /assets/audio/earned-it.mp3 (or any Weeknd-specific filename).
Music controls (play/pause and mute/volume slider) remain available and continue to work with local static audio files.
If the audio file is missing, the UI still shows a clear, English error/help message indicating the user must add a local audio file.

requirements.text: Add a small, simple corner image of the girlfriend using the user-uploaded photo, styled to be decorative and non-intrusive (e.g., small size, rounded corners/circle, subtle border/shadow), and ensure it appears consistently on both the initial and success screens without obstructing existing content or controls.

quotes: add a simple image of her in corner

acceptanceCriteria: A small girlfriend photo is visible in a page corner (consistent placement) on both the initial and success views.
The corner image does not cover the proposal text, buttons, or (remaining) music controls on common mobile and desktop viewport sizes.
The image is served as a static asset from the frontend (no backend fetching).
The corner image has simple, polished styling (e.g., rounded shape and subtle border/shadow) consistent with the existing romantic theme.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep audio strictly local/static (no streaming embeds or external audio sources).
nonGoals: No new authentication or data persistence features.

edits: Create a small, clean corner avatar-style crop from the uploaded photo (WhatsApp Image 2026-02-11 at 19.46.32.jpeg > girlfriend-corner.dim_256x256.png)
